title: (Optional) Define New Red Variant in Button Component
description: If a suitable red variant does not exist, add a new variant to the Button component for consistent styling.
details: In `components/ui/button.tsx`, extend the `buttonVariants` object to include a new variant (e.g., `red` or `customRed`) with Tailwind classes for the desired red background and hover states. Update the Button's TypeScript types to recognize the new variant. Ensure the new variant does not conflict with existing styles.
test_strategy: Render a Button with the new variant in isolation (e.g., Storybook or a test page) and verify its appearance and hover/focus states. Confirm accessibility (color contrast) and consistency with the design system.

title: Manual Visual and Functional Verification
description: Verify that the button appears red and functions correctly on the dashboard.
details: After making the code changes, run the application locally or in a preview environment. Navigate to the dashboard and visually inspect the '+ Create New Key' button. Ensure it is red, matches the intended design, and still triggers its action. Optionally, check color contrast for accessibility compliance.
test_strategy: Manual QA: visually inspect the dashboard, click the button to ensure it works, and use browser dev tools to confirm the applied styles. Optionally, use an accessibility checker to verify color contrast.

title: Inspect and Confirm Button Variant Support
description: Review the shadcn/ui Button component to determine if a red (destructive) variant exists or needs to be created.
details: Open `components/ui/button.tsx` and examine the `buttonVariants` object defined using class-variance-authority (cva). Check for a `destructive` or red-colored variant. If it exists, note its usage. If not, plan to add a new variant (e.g., `variant: 'red'`) with appropriate Tailwind CSS classes (e.g., `bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600`). Ensure the variant aligns with the application's design system and Tailwind config.
test_strategy: Verify that the Button component supports a red/destructive variant by checking the code and, if necessary, rendering a test button with the variant in Storybook or a local test page.

title: Update Dashboard Button to Use Red Variant
description: Modify the '+ Create New Key' button on the dashboard to use the red variant.
details: In `app/dashboard/page.tsx`, locate the '+ Create New Key' button. Change its usage from `<Button>...</Button>` to `<Button variant="destructive">...</Button>` (or the new variant name if created). Ensure no other buttons are unintentionally affected.
test_strategy: Run the app locally and visually confirm that the '+ Create New Key' button on the dashboard is now red. Check that the button remains functional and that no other buttons are affected.
